purpose: The building-block catalogue for the family private-doctor app. Each block is one independently composable unit with a stable id, a canonical cross-client page id, a route, an i18n label key, and a surface presentation. Clients compose these blocks instead of hard-coding navigation, and a deployment can reorder, hide, or relabel them. The catalogue is exactly the three tabs (chat / doctor / me); the browser workbench landing is a route, not a tab.

blocks.description: Family-doctor conversation with the active patient's facts and triage per exchange.
Human doctor directory: choose the family doctor and start a human consultation.
Patient files, my doctors, visit records, active mode, device checks.

landing.purpose: The browser workbench landing at the surface root. It is a route, not a tab, so the tab count stays three on every client.

blockOverrides.hidden: hide a block without removing it from the catalogue
blockOverrides.order: reorder visible blocks; unknown ids are ignored
blockOverrides.labels: replace a block label with a deployment-specific key

rules: block ids and routes come from this contract; a client never invents one
overrides are validated and invalid values fall back to the default
optional blocks may be hidden; required blocks may not

pc.presentation: icon rail with three tabs plus workbench landing

h5.presentation: bottom tabs with three tabs plus workbench landing
